improvements: The bot no longer plans protected travel through unopened chests and similar containers. It can still approach them as destinations, but does not mistake opening a container for walking past it.
incoming_learnings: Protected movement plans must distinguish container interactions from walking. A held key can be consumed at an intermediate chest, leaving the intended key pickup unreachable. Keep protection budgets, observed pickup receipts and mandatory progression requirements intact; do not infer an unidentified potion effect or replace planner exhaustion with idle waits.

review.review: The hero remained alive at full health when mandatory potion discovery exhausted the planner. Decision 13 opened the gas-room entrance; decision 14 escaped the observed gas. Chests at 300 and 376 remained unresolved. At decision 337, missing purity blocked general discovery, while room preparation and information-gathering alternatives declined. Offline reconstruction from the played source and recorded public inputs matches all 337 earlier selections and reproduces the terminal blocker; this is reconstructed bookkeeping, not recorded memory. Copied-state probes find hypothetical protected chest trips but no compatible safe unknown-potion bank, both at initial gas sight and at exhaustion. All 20 terminal trip origins independently fail terrain or surrounding-terrain admission; removing hunger in a diagnostic probe does not produce a bank. No unknown potion effect was inferred. No patch is supplied because weakening these checks risks fire, while remote testing can consume needed protection before retrieval. The available known liquid flame does not yet have a validated terrain-clearance, inventory-protection and fresh-arrival contract. Source browsing and reconstruction resolve the selecting-state uncertainty, but not that safety gap. The unchanged Python suite passes 1856 tests with four skipped; no candidate or red/green regression is claimed.
review.learnings: A hypothetical protected chest route does not establish an executable potion experiment. Gas-room preparation needs a safe drink bank, protected inventory and a verified return using actual observed protection. Here flammable or unknown surroundings prevent bank admission independently of hunger. Preserve the supply obligation and terminal failure label rather than guess a potion, eat generally early or waive unresolved pickups.

The exact blocker is flammable or unknown terrain around every budgeted drink origin, not missing selecting source or merely hunger. Known liquid flame is carried, but no validated containment, safe firing/retreat, potion-collateral protection or fresh clearance contract supports using it here. Next derive the observed entrance/grass-pocket/chest-route fixture and validate bounded known-flame terrain preparation with accepted throw receipts, contained spread, expiry and fresh bank/stash admission. Add refusal regressions for unknown spread, threatened escape, collateral loot, active effects and failed receipts. If containment fails, establish nonconsumptive identification instead; do not relax hazard checks or waive pickup. No policy patch or new regression is certified.
